_brief: Item 13 (batch 2026-10-03) TELL ME UR GOOD NEWS / TAL TEL AVIV - the dedicated Tel Aviv compilation. Tal's premise line once at the top, then 8 strangers: never two similar people in a row, the strongest (the Ghana woman, IMG_9504) 4th, end on the warmest (the everyday-philanthropist). NO ZOOMS (Tal, 'stop with all the zooms its weird', LESSONS 80): every beat has one constant static framing; the same take keeps the same framing across its jump cut. Location sound, no music, grade off (bright iPhone daylight, LESSONS 72). Excluded: IMG_9515 (man says 'can you not record?'), the refusals (9501/9502/9505/9510/9517-9520), and every line about hate/racism/Oct 7 (nothing negative).

PREMISE: Tal walks in with the sign - 'let's ask people to share their good news with me right now'
young mum (Mexico): 'I'm here in Tel Aviv with my son - that's the good news'. Static crop set so her baby in the stroller is OUT of frame (LESSONS 81: a stranger's child is not shown)
backpack guy: 'good news? the rain stopped' - a quick laugh, Tal's question cut
STRONGEST: the Ghana woman - 'the good news is I've met you' + Tal 'oh wow you're so sweet'
...'because you're the first person who's spoken to me since I left the house' (Tal's 'why me' cut; same take, same framing)
Yankees fan: 'the Yankees just beat the Red Sox in the wild card - let's go man' - the laugh after the emotional one; Tal's question cut

Jessica (moved from Paris): 'my dream? I just made it, actually - we made Aliyah this summer, so now I'm very happy' (her 'first of all, I love you' walk-in was dropped: too faint for the speech detector to place a caption)
linen-shirt guy: 'last week I've been living in a hut'
...'what makes you happy in life is not material things at all' (same take, same framing)
grandmother: 'my good news - to have a granddaughter in Israel, that we're with her for Chag'
ENDING, bucket-hat man: 'my personal dream is to be a small, everyday philanthropist'
...'because it just brings joy - buy a coffee, buy a meal' - kindness as the last word (same take, same framing)
